messages.content: The Idaho hosts just sent changes before I booked everything. Boise breakfast check-in is now 7:00 a.m., the Nampa fair ends at 8:35 p.m., and Twin Falls wants me there at 8:15 Wednesday. Forecast says possible snow along I-84. Should I still drive, and where would you put Tuesday night?

I would still plan around driving unless the forecast worsens. The flight into Boise works, but it adds rental pickup time and makes the return home less flexible. One thing affects reliability: are you willing to drive Nampa to Twin Falls after the fair only if the road check is clean, or would you rather avoid any late drive regardless?
I can do the late drive if it is cold and dry. I do not want to do it in active snow or ice. University vehicle is approved now, so use that assumption.

Then Tuesday night should be Twin Falls as the primary plan, with Nampa/Meridian as the weather escape. Boise is no longer useful Tuesday because it makes Wednesday too tight. Nampa is safer if weather is active, but it means a 5:10 to 5:20 a.m. start. Twin Falls gives you the best chance of being calm for the 8:15 arrival if the post-fair roads are dry.
Okay. Give me the drive windows if Twin Falls stays primary.

Monday: leave Salt Lake about 12:15 p.m., quick fuel/rest stop around Burley or Heyburn, arrive Boise 5:45 to 6:15. Tuesday: leave the Boise hotel by 6:35 for the 7:00 breakfast check-in. After the Nampa fair, do not linger: depart the venue 8:45 to 8:55 only if ITD shows clear pavement/no traction alerts; Twin Falls arrival should be about 10:35 to 10:50. Wednesday: leave the Twin Falls hotel 7:35, arrive school around 7:55 to 8:00.
Book the hotel setup around that. I do not want breakfast timing to be a gamble.

I would use the Boise downtown/Boise State hold Monday, but treat hotel breakfast as backup only because of the 7:00 check-in. For Tuesday, the Twin Falls Pole Line/Blue Lakes room is better: free parking, breakfast starts early enough, and it can take a late-arrival note. Do you want the Nampa/Meridian backup kept until the Tuesday afternoon road check?
Yes, keep the backup. Queen room is fine. I just need parking and easy food.

Got it. Boise Monday: queen room, parking confirmed, restaurants within a short drive. Twin Falls Tuesday: queen room, free parking, breakfast available, late-arrival note. Nampa/Meridian backup: cancellable, free parking, breakfast, and closer to dinner options if you have to stop there.
Do it. Also tell me where to eat and fuel so I am not hunting after the fair.

Booked the Boise Monday room and Twin Falls Tuesday room; kept the Nampa/Meridian backup. Food and fuel plan: Monday dinner near the Boise hotel after arrival. Tuesday morning, bring a coffee/bar from the hotel and eat properly after the Boise breakfast event. Before the Nampa fair, eat around Nampa Marketplace at about 5:15. After the fair, top off near Garrity before getting on I-84; do not add a dinner stop during the late drive. Wednesday, use the hotel breakfast at 6:45 and fuel after the school visit before heading back to Salt Lake.
And release the flight backup?

Yes, release the Boise flight backup. It does not improve the Wednesday arrival enough to justify rental-car timing and return constraints. Keep these weather triggers: Monday 4:00 p.m. forecast check, Tuesday 3:30 p.m. ITD check, and a final 8:40 p.m. road check from Nampa. If there is active snow, freezing rain, traction control, or closures between Nampa, Mountain Home, and Twin Falls, stay in Nampa and leave at 5:10 Wednesday with packed breakfast.

messages.content: Switching to family logistics now. Early December Las Vegas tournament for three of us. Draft has Friday evening team check-in, Saturday pool play, and maybe a Sunday afternoon championship. Can you compare flying Friday afternoon versus driving from Salt Lake, and look at refundable hotels near the venue?
Sure. Which venue in Las Vegas, and can your teenager leave school early Friday? Also, are you trying to avoid a late Sunday return if the championship runs long?
Venue is Las Vegas Sports Park in Summerlin. He can leave after lunch if needed. Sunday could be midafternoon, so I do not want a return plan that falls apart if they make the final.

Here is the practical comparison. Flying: Friday afternoon nonstop options would be quick in the air, but for three tickets plus bags and ground transport, the total is likely much higher, and a Sunday final makes a 6-ish return flight uncomfortable. Driving: leave Salt Lake around 12:15 to 12:45, arrive Summerlin about 5:45 to 6:30 local with stops and the time change, and you keep control of Sunday. Unless fares are unusually low, driving is the steadier family plan.
If we flew, would we need a rental car?

For that venue, probably yes. Rideshares from the airport, to the hotel, to games, and back can add up, especially with gear. A weekend rental gives flexibility but adds pickup time, parking questions, and another Sunday deadline. That makes flying less attractive unless you find a very good nonstop fare.
Then do not book flights yet. Show me hotels that are not a resort-fee surprise. Breakfast matters Saturday, and Friday dinner should be easy.

Shortlist: 1) La Quinta/Summerlin Tech area: about 8-10 minutes to the Sports Park, free breakfast, free parking, no resort fee, refundable two-queen rooms showing, but dinner is a short drive rather than walkable. 2) Hampton Inn Red Rock/Summerlin area: about 17-20 minutes to the venue, free breakfast, free parking, no resort fee, better nearby restaurants, refundable two-queen rooms. 3) Red Rock Resort: strong food options and easy parking, but the resort fee and no included breakfast make it less practical for this weekend.
Could you hold two rooms? One closest to the venue and one with better restaurant access. Two queen beds if possible, not a sofa bed.

Yes. I will hold the closer La Quinta/Summerlin Tech two-queen room and the Hampton Inn Red Rock/Summerlin two-queen room. Both are refundable, both avoid resort fees, and both include breakfast. If the first match is early, the closer one will be the better choice; if the schedule starts later, the restaurant-area option is more comfortable.
Check parking too. We will have gear, and I do not want to pay casino-style fees just to sleep.

Both hotel holds include self-parking with no separate hotel parking fee shown. Venue parking should be free, but it may fill early on tournament mornings, so plan to arrive 40-45 minutes before the first game. I would skip casino/resort properties unless the schedule changes and you decide food access matters more than fees.
Please set the holds and give me the reminders. We will decide once the bracket posts.

Set: refundable two-queen hold at La Quinta/Summerlin Tech and refundable two-queen hold at Hampton Inn Red Rock/Summerlin. No flights booked. Reminders: bracket check when posted, compare first-game time against the morning drive from each hotel, cancel one hold before its deadline, and recheck Friday departure time once school release is confirmed. Driving remains the planning assumption for now.

Drive. The Sunday window makes flights expensive and awkward, and the car keeps the return flexible. With a 7:45 first match, keep the closer La Quinta/Summerlin Tech hold. The Red Rock-area hotel has better dinner options, but the extra morning drive is not worth it for that early start.

The closer hold is a two-queen room, refundable, with free parking and no resort fee shown. Breakfast starts at 6:00. Plan on quick breakfast at 6:05, gear check by 6:30, leave hotel by 6:45, and arrive at the venue around 7:00. Pack bars and fruit in case the breakfast line is slow.
What should Friday look like now that we do not have to make check-in?

Leave Salt Lake after lunch without rushing: target 12:30 p.m., quick stop around Cedar City, optional top-off or snack in St. George, then hotel arrival around 6:15 to 6:45 local depending on traffic. Eat close to the hotel and keep Saturday clothes and gear separated so the early morning is simple.
Can you ask for late checkout? If they make the final, we will have bags.

I will request 1:00 p.m. late checkout, but it is not guaranteed. Since Sunday could run until 3:30, plan to pack the car before the first game. Treat late checkout as a convenience, not the main bag plan.
Set the reminders and release the other hold.

Done. Kept the closer two-queen La Quinta/Summerlin Tech room and released the Red Rock/Summerlin backup. Set reminders for: payment/cancellation check tomorrow, Friday 12:30 departure, Saturday 6:05 breakfast, Saturday 6:45 hotel departure, Sunday pack-car-before-games, and late-checkout follow-up at check-in. No flights booked.
